name: nix_list_items
description: List an item's direct children (id, title, type, whether it has children) with their property values: dueDate, startDate and completed when the task fields exist, other values under properties. Omit parentId to list the workspace root. Read-only; reads may run without a card; changes always ask for approval.

name: nix_search
description: Search this workspace by title or content: returns matching items and the passages that best answer the query, matched by meaning as well as words. Read-only; reads may run without a card; changes always ask for approval.

name: nix_read_item
description: Read one item's id, title, type and workspace. Read-only.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_read_note
description: Read a note's text, or a file item's content: text, CSV, JSON and PDF as text, images as a picture. Read-only.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_search_note
description: Find the passages that best answer a question in a note and every note under it, with each passage's note, heading and position. Use for a note too long to read whole (nix_read_note returned partial) or a question about a note's children. Read-only.

itemId.description: The note (or folder or collection) whose text, and whose descendants’ text, to search.

query.description: The question or topic, in plain words.

name: nix_read_structure
description: Read an item's effective and declared fields, complete view configuration, default and companion views, renderability and child count. Start an existing-view review here. Read-only.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_read_view
description: Read at most 25 permission-filtered results for one saved view. Read nix_read_structure first for its exact viewId. Returns configuration, counts, truncation and display limitations; a sample cannot prove the whole view. Read-only.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

viewId.description: The exact saved view id, from nix_read_structure.

name: nix_create_note
description: Create a new note with title and markdown, under parentId (omit for the workspace root). Shown for approval before it runs.

name: nix_append_note
description: Append Markdown to a note's body. Never replaces existing content.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_replace_section
description: Replace one section of a note: the blocks from the heading named heading up to the next heading of the same or higher level. The rest of the note is untouched. If markdown does not start with a heading, the original heading is kept. Refuses when the heading is missing or not unique. Call nix_read_note first. Never replaces a whole note's body.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

heading.description: The exact heading text, without # marks (case is ignored); must be unique in the note.

markdown.description: The new Markdown for that section.

name: nix_replace_passage
description: Fix text inside one paragraph, heading, list item text or code block: find must occur exactly once in the note and inside a single block (no list markers). Only that block is rewritten. Call nix_read_note first.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

find.description: The exact Markdown text to replace, up to 240 characters.

replace.description: The Markdown text to put in its place; may be empty.

name: nix_rename_item
description: Rename an item. Never changes anything else about it.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_move_item
description: Move an item under a new parent. Supply an empty parentId to move it to the workspace root.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_set_properties
description: Set one or more of an item's property values. Call nix_read_structure first.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

properties.description: One or more property values, keyed by field key (see nix_read_structure).

name: nix_trash_item
description: Move an item to trash. Recoverable with nix_restore_item; never permanent.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_restore_item
description: Restore a trashed item.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_create_structured
description: Create a new item with a recipe, fields and up to 6 views per call, under parentId (omit for the workspace root). Items support at most 12 views total. Shown for approval before it runs. choiceSource:{} learns this field from sibling entries; set itemId for another note and field for a child field or title. Task fields use their type as the key: due_date, start_date, completion, priority, estimate, reminder; omit key or set it to that type, with any label. Formula fields use a bare expression without a leading =. Read exact, case-sensitive property keys as [key], never labels, prop() or PROPERTY(). Declare new formula inputs with explicit keys; read existing keys with nix_read_structure. Use double-quoted text, commas between arguments, = for equality, <> for inequality and AND/OR/NOT for logic. Cells, ranges, JavaScript, TODAY and NOW are unsupported. Supported functions only: ABS, AND, AVERAGE, CONCATENATE, CONTAINS, COUNT, COUNTA, DAYS, IF, IFERROR, INT, ISBLANK, LEFT, LEN, LOWER, MAX, MID, MIN, MOD, NOT, OR, POWER, RIGHT, ROUND, ROUNDDOWN, ROUNDUP, SQRT, SUM, TRIM, UPPER, VALUE. Examples: [price] * [quantity]; IF([completion], "Done", "Open"); IFERROR(ROUND([price] * [quantity], 2), 0). DAYS(end, start) subtracts date-only YYYY-MM-DD values; timestamps are unsupported. A formula reads this item; use a rollup to aggregate children. Computed values cannot be assigned. For form and interactive_form views, mode:"temporary" keeps answers in memory and creates no entry; mode:"saved" creates entries. Put calculations in formula schema fields, not input blocks.

name: nix_add_view

Read nix_read_structure.viewCapacity first and split batches within remaining capacity. Never removes or retypes a field, never deletes an existing view. itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_create_entries
description: Create up to 25 child entries under parentId in one call.

values.description: Values are keyed by field key (see nix_read_structure), never by field label.

name: nix_edit_fields
description: Edit existing locally declared fields, including type and choiceSource. Read nix_read_structure first and supply exact keys and complete field definitions. Existing values are retained without conversion; always requires approval. Cannot remove fields.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_update_view
description: Refine one existing view using exact field keys from nix_read_structure. Only patch named settings; unmentioned settings, fields, kind, default and companions stay intact. Shows before and after and always asks for approval. Use nix_edit_form for form pages; read structure and results back after success. On a custom view, patch.program replaces its whole program. For form and interactive_form views, mode:"temporary" keeps answers in memory and creates no entry; mode:"saved" creates entries. Put calculations in formula schema fields, not input blocks.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_set_recurrence
description: Set or replace a recurring due-date rule on an item.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_list_templates
description: List templates available in this workspace, optionally filtered by query. Read-only.

name: nix_read_template
description: Read one template's details. Read-only.

name: nix_apply_template
description: Apply a template to create a new item under parentId (omit for the workspace root), filling any inputs the template declares. Shown for approval before it runs.

name: nix_build_blueprint
description: Build a whole design (items, fields, views and samples) in one approval, under Pet drafts unless parentId names a parent. Nix checks it before the owner sees it: a design with problems comes back declined with every problem listed; fix them all and call once more. Up to 6 views per node, 20 per blueprint. choiceSource:{} learns this field from sibling entries; set itemId for another note and field for a child field or title. Task fields use their type as the key: due_date, start_date, completion, priority, estimate, reminder; omit key or set it to that type, with any label. name: nix_save_as_template
description: Save an item and its children as a reusable template named title. Excludes descendants titled "Sample: ..." by default.

itemId.description: The source item UUID.

name: nix_read_calendar
description: Read every dated item in this workspace's calendars between from and to (inclusive, at most 31 days): title, container, date, end date, and completion for repeating tasks. Read-only.

to.description: The last day, yyyy-MM-dd, at most 30 days after from.

name: nix_complete_task
description: Mark a task done (completed true) or not done (false). A repeating task completes its current occurrence and moves on to the next. Refuses an item with no completion field. Shown for approval before it runs.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

completed.description: true to mark it done, false to reopen it.

name: nix_remember
description: Save one lasting fact or preference the owner stated about themselves, or asked you to remember, so later conversations know it. Runs without a card; the owner sees and edits every memory in Settings > Pets > Memory. Never for note content, tool output or secrets.

fact.description: The fact in one short sentence, at most 280 characters.
